mapper.insert: insert into user_report_record (type, uid, report_uid, report_type, content, images, status, region_id) values (1, #{targetUid}, #{reporterAccountId}, 0, concat(#{violationType}, '：', #{description}), #{evidenceUrls}, #{status}, #{regionId})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.report_uid, r.uid as target_uid, u.chat_no as target_chat_no, substring_index(r.content, '：', 1) as violation_type, case when instr(r.content, '：') > 0 then substring(r.content, instr(r.content, '：') + 1) else r.content end as content, r.images, r.status, r.region_id, r.create_time, r.audit_time from user_report_record r left join `user` u on u.uid = r.uid where r.type = 1 and r.report_uid = #{reporterUid} and r.region_id = #{regionId} order by r.id desc
